title: Cancel contract
description: Cancel your care contract here. You get a confirmation right away.
chooseTitle: What would you like to do?
ordinaryHint: This is the next possible date.
specialHint: Only with a reason named in the contract, for example a move.
withdrawalHint: Possible until {date}. The contract then never applied.
withdrawalClosed: The withdrawal period is over. You can only cancel the contract now.
summaryTermination: Your contract ends on {date}. Until then, care takes place as booked.
summaryWithdrawal: The contract is undone from the start. If you already paid, you get it back.
summaryWithdrawalEarly: The contract is undone from the start. You asked for care to start early. So you pay for the days until today.
confirmationHint: You get a confirmation by e-mail right away.
notActive: This contract no longer applies or does not apply yet. You cannot cancel it here. If you have questions, contact the provider.
doneTermination: Your cancellation has been received. The contract ends on {date}.
doneWithdrawal: Your withdrawal has been received. The contract is undone.
datesChanged: The dates have changed. Please choose again.
extraordinaryHint: Only for an important reason. The provider checks it. If the provider does not accept it, your cancellation counts as an ordinary cancellation.
reasonHint: Briefly write why you are ending the contract.
summaryExtraordinary: The provider checks your reason. If it accepts the reason, it sets the end of the contract. If not, the contract ends on the next possible date, like with an ordinary cancellation. You will get the decision by e-mail. Until then, care continues as booked.
doneExtraordinary: Your cancellation has been received. The provider checks your reason. You will get the decision by e-mail and here in the app.
endsOpen: The provider sets it after checking
doneDecidedSet: The provider has checked your reason. The contract ends on {date}.
doneDecidedReinterpreted: The provider does not accept your reason. Your cancellation counts as an ordinary cancellation. The contract ends on {date}.
decisionReinterpreted: Reason not accepted. Counts as an ordinary cancellation.
endNoticeTitle: Message from the provider about the end of the contract
